ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Child Care Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial transactions and funding streams involved in the Minnesota child care fraud scandal.
questions: What are the primary funding sources for Minnesota's childcare system?
How are these funds being allocated and used?
ideas.insight: By analyzing the financial transactions and funding streams involved in the scandal, we may be able to identify patterns and connections that can help us better understand the extent of the fraud and the individuals or organizations involved.
